articles.title: 1st snow arrives early in Seoul, but warmer, wetter winter expected
articles.description: Seoul recorded its first snowfall of the season Sunday, nearly a month earlier than last year, with light flurries observed in the capital. According to the Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA), the first snow was observed at the Seoul Meteorological Observatory in Jongno District.
